notes: The Opta's USB-C and ETH RJ45 ports are not in the catalogue's port list, so edges to them have a null port on the Opta side. The USB cable has no ports, so its ports are null as well.
In the diagram both Opta ETH cables join a shared blue network line. I modelled that line as the optional Ethernet switch, with each Opta cabled to a separate switch port.
The diagram's Modbus TCP compatible device is not in the hardware list, and its link to the network is dashed. I left it out as an optional field-deployment extra.

Each Opta's USB-C cable goes to the computer running the PLC IDE. The computer is modelled as a new part type with two USB ports (USB.1 and USB.2); this is an assumption, since in practice a hub or sequential connection may be used.
The Opta in the diagram's left position is the Slave/Server (192.168.1.2) and the right one is the Master/Client (192.168.1.1).
Software configuration (IP addresses, Modbus roles, PLC code) is recorded only as part properties, not as graph edges.
